questions.question: What is gambling addiction?
questions.answer: Gambling addiction is an impulse control disorder where a person cannot resist the need to gamble, even when it negatively affects their personal, work, family, or financial life.

questions.question: What are the most common signs that I have a gambling problem?
answer: Betting more money than you can afford to lose.
Lying to family or friends about the time or money spent gambling.
Trying to stop gambling without success.
Using gambling as an escape from problems, sadness, or stress.
Going into debt or borrowing money to keep gambling.

questions.question: Can gambling addiction be cured?
questions.answer: Gambling addiction is a disorder that can be controlled with professional help, personal commitment, and the right support. Many people are able to stop gambling and live a full life.

questions.question: What should I do if a family member or friend has gambling addiction?
questions.answer: The best approach is to support them without judgment, encourage them to seek help, and avoid lending them money to gamble. You can also guide them to use the application or contact a specialist.

questions.question: Does the application replace professional help?
questions.answer: No. The app is a support, reflection, and accompaniment tool, but it does not replace psychological or medical therapy. We always recommend reaching out to health professionals.

questions.question: What resources will I find inside the app?
answer: Strategies that have helped others stop gambling.
A community where you can find stories and experiences from people who have also faced gambling addiction.

questions.question: What should I do if I have an emergency and feel like I am going to relapse?
questions.answer: The app includes an “assistance” section with immediate advice, support contacts, and reminders of your goals. We also recommend calling a family member or a help line.

questions.question: Can I use the application if I do not have gambling addiction?
questions.answer: Yes. The app is also useful if you want to learn about gambling addiction, support a loved one, or prevent risky behavior.

questions.question: What happens if I relapse?
questions.answer: A relapse does not mean failure. It is part of the recovery process. The app will allow you to record the experience, reflect on it, and receive guidance to get back on track.

questions.question: Will my personal data be safe?
questions.answer: Yes. The application protects your information with security systems and does not share your data with third parties without your consent.

questions.question: Does the app track my location or movements?
questions.answer: No, unless you authorize it for specific features, such as locating nearby help groups. Privacy is always a priority.

questions.question: Who can see my information inside the app?
questions.answer: Only you can see your evaluation, commitment, and chat information. If you decide to share stories or strategies with the community, other users will be able to see that information.

questions.question: Is the application free?
answer: The app has a free version with basic resources.
There is also a premium version with additional tracking and support tools.

questions.question: How can I access the premium version?
questions.answer: You can subscribe from the app using a credit card, debit card, or secure digital wallet.

questions.question: What should I do if I have a technical problem with the application?
questions.answer: In the “Help and Support” section you will find a contact form or email to report errors and receive assistance.

questions.question: Where can I find more help outside the application?
questions.answer: The app includes a directory of emergency numbers, local and international support groups, and professionals specialized in gambling addiction.

community.title: To the Community
community.subtitle: Help fund the giveaway prizes.
community.description:
Community donations work as follows: randomly selected users browsing the site will be eligible to win a percentage of your donation. They will receive a notification that they have a chance to win a prize.

The formula is simple: (donated amount / monthly subscription price = number of subscription months to be awarded). For example, if your donation is $100 and the subscription cost is $5 per month, the number of subscription months to be awarded will be 20.

Spin for users without a subscription:

1 free month of subscription (40% probability)
2 free months of subscription (30% probability)
3 free months of subscription (15% probability)
5 free months of subscription (10% probability)
12 free months of subscription (5% probability)

The amount you choose to donate will be distributed among the community and will depend on the randomness of the machine that will decide which users can win the subscription months.

The Spin that will appear will be the following:

DebtPolicy.title: Debt Information
DebtPolicy.policy:
Information Confidentiality

• All entered data (amount, creditor, dates, payments) are private and only visible to the user.
• The application will not share or sell this information to third parties.

Use of Information

• The registered information will be used solely for personal debt control within the application.
• Calculations, reminders, and generated reports have an informative purpose and support for the user.

Data Accuracy

• The user is responsible for correctly entering amounts, dates, and creditors.
• The application assumes no responsibility for errors in information registered by the user.

Notifications and Reminders

• The system may send notifications or alerts related to debt maturities, payments, or reports, as long as the user allows it.

Limitation of Liability

• The application is not a financial entity, nor does it collect or manage real payments.
• Its function is solely to organize and facilitate the control of personal debts.
